bio.text: Brandon Herrera owns a small firearms manufacturing company near San Antonio and is known on YouTube as The AK Guy.

He pushed U.S. Rep. Tony Gonzales into a Republican primary runoff in both 2024 and 2026; after the March 2026 primary Gonzales dropped his reelection bid, making Herrera the Republican nominee for Texas's 23rd Congressional District.
In his candidate questionnaire he says he began studying pre-law before choosing entrepreneurship.
